_about: Verified PCMC citizen-service information for the chatbot (RAG). Every fact comes from the sourceUrl on the date in lastVerified. Add entries only from official PCMC sources. Zone-office entries are generated from config/pcmc.json at load time.

documents.title: Property tax (PCMC Tax Assessment and Collection Department)
documents.content: PCMC property tax is handled by the Tax Collection (कर संकलन) department. PCMC's official e-Seva page links citizens to the online property tax portal at publicptaxpcmc.in. On that portal citizens can link their property with their mobile number. The official pages we checked do not list the payment steps, payment modes, rebates or deadlines; those are shown on the property tax portal itself. For help, citizens can call the PCMC main line 020-67333333 or the Sarathi helpline 8888006666.
documents.source: PCMC e-Seva page and property tax portal

documents.title: Pay or check your PCMC water bill online
documents.content: PCMC water bills can be paid online on the official water bill payment page. To open your bill you need your water Consumer ID, the mobile number linked to that Consumer ID, and an email address; an OTP is sent to the mobile number for verification. The page shows the pending amount, total and paid amounts, instalment progress and billing history (bill date, amount, penalties, balance). A No Dues Certificate for water charges can be downloaded there. Consumers who want to update their mobile number must visit the water supply department at their municipal ward office. The page does not describe new water connections or water complaints; water supply complaints can be registered as a civic complaint.
documents.source: PCMC online water bill payment page

documents.title: Birth and death registration and certificates
documents.content: Birth and death certificates in PCMC limits are obtained through the Government of India Civil Registration System (CRS) portal at crsorgi.gov.in, for recent records and for earlier records. PCMC lists registration offices at: Jijamata Hospital (Pimpri), Pradhikaran (Sindhunagar, LIG Colony), Akurdi Hospital, Fugewadi (Junna Zakat Naka), Thergaon (Gujarnagar), Sangvi (Sangvi municipal school area), Bhosari, Talera (Tanaji Nagar, Chinchwad), Pimpri Waghere and YCM Hospital. The official page does not list fees, processing time or a document checklist. Contact: PCMC 020-67333333, email egov@pcmcindia.gov.in, Sarathi helpline 8888006666.
documents.source: PCMC birth and death information page

documents.title: Building permission (BPAMS)
documents.content: Building permission applications in PCMC are made online through BPAMS, the Building Permission and Management System, at bldp.pcmcindia.gov.in/BPAMSClient. Licensed engineers, surveyors, architects, site engineers and structural engineers register through BPAMS. The PCMC page refers to Form IA, environmental clearance (a self-declaration option is available), No Objection Certificates, revenue land documentation under Section 44A of the Revenue Act 1966, and affidavits and bonds. It does not give a full document checklist, step-by-step procedure or fees. The responsible department is Building Permission & Unauthorised Construction Control. Contact: PCMC 020-67333333, email egov@pcmcindia.gov.in.

documents.title: Registering civic complaints and the Sarathi helpline
documents.content: PCMC's Sarathi helpline number is 8888006666. PCMC's e-Seva page lists an official Grievance Registration service. On this portal, citizens can also register a civic complaint (for example garbage, potholes, water supply, drainage or street lights); it is automatically routed to the concerned PCMC department and zone, and the citizen receives a ticket number such as PCMC-100001 to track it.

documents.title: Tracking a complaint filed on this portal
documents.content: A complaint filed on this portal can be tracked on the Track Complaint page by entering the ticket number (for example PCMC-100001) together with the email address used when filing it. The status, department, zone, priority, submission date, last update and expected resolution date are shown. Complaints filed with PCMC's own Sarathi or grievance system are tracked there, not on this portal.

documents.title: Other PCMC online services (e-Seva)
documents.content: PCMC's e-Seva page lists these online citizen services: Property Tax, Water Tax, Birth and Death Certificate, Building Permission, Local Body Tax, Grievance Registration, Right to Information (RTI), Marriage Registration, Fire NOC, Right to Services (RTS), Sports Booking, Pothole Management and CFC Application Status. RTI and Marriage Registration use the PCMC portal at noncoreerp.pcmcindia.gov.in.

documents.title: PCMC contact details
documents.content: Pimpri-Chinchwad Municipal Corporation headquarters is PCMC Bhavan in Pimpri. PCMC main phone numbers: 020-67333333 and 020-28333333. Email: egov@pcmcindia.gov.in. Sarathi citizen helpline: 8888006666. Official website: www.pcmcindia.gov.in.

documents.title: PCMC departments
documents.content: PCMC departments include: Civil Engineering (स्थापत्य), Electrical (विद्युत), Water Supply (पाणी पुरवठा), Drainage (जलनिःसारण), Health (आरोग्य), Medical (वैद्यकीय), Building Permission & Unauthorised Construction Control, Gardens (उद्यान), Environmental Engineering, Tax Collection (कर संकलन), Local Body Tax, Disaster Management, Fire (अग्निशामक), Primary and Secondary Education, Veterinary (पशुवैद्यकीय), Slum Elimination & Rehabilitation, Town Planning (नगर रचना), Information & Technology, Sports and Legal.

documents.title: Electricity bills and power supply (MSEDCL / Mahavitaran, not PCMC)
documents.content: Electricity bills and household power supply in Pimpri-Chinchwad are handled by MSEDCL (Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd., known as Mahavitaran), not by PCMC. Bills can be viewed and paid online through the Consumer Portal / Quick Bill Payment on the MSEDCL website mahadiscom.in, or in the official Mahavitaran mobile app (Google Play and Apple App Store), which also supports meter reading submission, new connections and mobile number registration. For power supply complaints, MSEDCL's toll-free numbers are 1912 or 19120 (national) and 1800-233-3435 or 1800-212-3435 (MSEDCL). Street lights on public roads are a PCMC matter and can be reported as a civic complaint.
